title: Lafise Bank — Poket Project
overview: Poket is a B2C digital banking product for Lafise Bank — a neobank experience designed from scratch for the Latin American market, focusing on financial inclusion and ease of use.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.content: Lafise needed a mobile-first banking product that could compete with emerging neobanks while serving users with varying levels of digital literacy across Central America.

sections.alt: Service design workshop with Lafise stakeholders
sections.caption: Co-design workshops with stakeholders

sections.label: Process
sections.content: As both Product Owner and Lead Designer, I defined the product vision, managed the backlog, and ran bi-weekly sprints. Conducted service design workshops across 3 countries to map the full customer journey from onboarding to first transaction.

sections.label: Outcome
sections.content: Launched to 50,000 users in the first quarter. The onboarding flow reduced KYC drop-off by 38% through a simplified identity verification UX tailored to local ID formats.
